claim_scope: Retrospective mechanism diagnosis on consumed development trajectories; not an effectiveness estimate.

distinctions.sufficient_state: The active construction environment satisfies the complete public goal.
distinctions.formed_program: A self-contained deployment program has been proposed for target-state execution.
distinctions.certified_program: The exact proposed program passes clean target-state replay.
distinctions.official_success: The delivered program passes EnvBench Official.
distinctions.deployment_completeness: Runtime completeness is a separate measured quality axis.

records.last_reproducible_state: The construction environment reached zero reportMissingImports at request 117, while import meerkat still failed under unresolved runtime dependency conflicts.
records.first_unresolved_constraint: The observed Official-sufficient state was not retained as a success-first delivery obligation because benchmark sufficiency and broader runtime completeness remained conflated.
records.decisive_operation: The Agent continued runtime diagnosis through the request cap instead of delivering the already sufficient environment as a program.
records.evidence_anchor: request 117 public-goal Pass followed by requests 118-120 without submission

records.last_reproducible_state: The Agent reduced the dependency surface but terminated with six missing imports caused by version drift, renamed packages, and unavailable sources.
records.first_unresolved_constraint: Observed package and namespace incompatibilities were not reconciled into one satisfiable environment before the request cap.
records.decisive_operation: No complete candidate was formed, so whole-program replay could not activate.
records.evidence_anchor: terminal six-missing-import goal result and zero replay calls

records.last_reproducible_state: The third complete program used Python 3.11 and passed clean replay and Official.
records.decisive_operation: The Agent changed interpreter after two audit-induced Unknown replays; this repair path is measurement-confounded.
records.evidence_anchor: Unknown, Unknown, Pass replay sequence followed by Official Pass

records.last_reproducible_state: A project-local Python 3.9 environment passed Official.
records.decisive_operation: The Agent preserved the declared interpreter and exposed the venv through PATH.
records.evidence_anchor: submitted Python 3.9 program and Official Pass

records.last_reproducible_state: The program installed Java and ANTLR tooling, generated parser sources, editable-installed both local projects, and passed Official.
records.decisive_operation: A broad CPU-compatible local development environment was delivered.
records.evidence_anchor: submitted full local-install program and Official Pass

records.last_reproducible_state: The first replayed program generated parser sources and installed enough tooling and runtime packages to pass Official after an exact-script evaluator retry.
records.decisive_operation: The Agent delivered a narrower metric-sufficient program on its first replay.
records.evidence_anchor: first replay Pass and exact-script Official retry Pass

records.last_reproducible_state: A temporary zero-missing-import result depended on a forbidden exclusion config; after removal, historical submodule and Python-2-era dependency conflicts remained.
records.first_unresolved_constraint: The unavailable historical submodule and incompatible legacy runtime requirements were observed but not reconciled legally.
records.decisive_operation: The Agent correctly removed the metric-invalid exclusion but found no legal replacement before the request cap.
records.evidence_anchor: zero valid replay calls and unresolved historical-revision/Python-2 constraints

records.last_reproducible_state: The Agent diagnosed the missing historical submodule and Python-2-era dependency surface but did not reach a legal public-goal Pass.
records.first_unresolved_constraint: Legacy source availability and runtime compatibility remained jointly unsatisfied.
records.decisive_operation: No valid environment operation sequence resolved both constraints before the request cap.

aggregate.central_transition_gap: A sufficient construction state and a replayable program are distinct; terminal program reconstruction leaves this transition model-dependent.
aggregate.next_hypothesis: Make the deployment program grow with successful environment operations so it already exists when the public goal becomes sufficient.
